The '''transit bridge''' was an area in the [[Network Security District]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Empire occupied the bridge, using it as their forward base in the district.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The transit bridge appears as part of the Network Security District on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
